messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch grooming for v1.4 follow-ons. We need to decide which tickets are bugs vs enhancements and what goes into the next patch vs milestone.
sam: Can we pull the top 8 from the board? I highlighted 5 that look like P0/P1.
alex: FYI infra saw a spike yesterday; might be caching invalidation. Logged as INC-472.
jordan: Design note — the modal alignment issue feels like a UX regression. Should we treat as a bug?
leo: Support has 12 reports about the embeddings reranker returning repeated artifacts. Users seeing duplicates.
maya: Proposal: classify as bugs only if crash/regression/safety/major UX break. Otherwise enhancement. Object?
sam: Fine. For each bug estimate fix+test. If <= 2 dev days, put in patch sprint; else milestone.
jordan: Modal alignment came after the rollout -> bug. I think ~1 day to fix + tests.
leo: Reranker hallucinations are inconsistent. Need repro dataset — mark as P1 enhancement until reproducible.
alex: Cache spike is infra-critical, caused latency > SLO. Mark INC-472 as P0 and schedule immediate investigation. I ran: `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep "kv_cache"` and saw repeated misses.
maya: I'll create a grooming card with tags: `bug/patch`, `bug/milestone`, `enhancement/backlog`. Add a "criteria" checklist: repro, test, blame, rollback plan.
sam: Can we add owner labels? I'll take INC-472 and the modal alignment fix.
jordan: I'll pair with Sam on modal tests and visual QA.
leo: I'll pull the user repros and share logs in #support-thread; will also add sample payloads to the ticket.
release-bot: Deploy v1.4.2 completed to staging at 2025-10-11 09:12 UTC :rocket:
maya: Timeline proposal: patch sprint Mon->Wed, milestone cut Fri. Everyone ok?
sam: Schedule works for eng. I'll add risk and test estimates to each ticket.
maya: Great — I'll update the board, assign owners, and ping for a quick grooming at 10am tomorrow. :thumbsup:
